# Test Suite Index

<!-- GENERATED by utils/internal/test-audit/main.das --readme from the [test] annotations; edit the tests, not this file -->

7 files: 7 test suites holding 65 `[test]` functions, 0 compile-fail fixtures, 0 scripts. How a test tree is laid out and what each class of file is: `tests/ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root.

## ./

### test_caches.das

- `test_module_cache_filenames` - a module cache file name is stable per source path, ends in .dascache, and changes with the path or the compile policies
- `test_invalid_worker_module_cache_path` - a fresh runner rejects a malformed worker module-cache path with exit code 1 and a named message
- `test_dastest_cache_per_test_file` - the persistent module cache keys one record per test file and survives across processes, plain and isolated, falling back on a same-stamp source edit
- `test_dastest_cache_compile_environment` - a changed compile-time environment value misses the module cache in plain and isolated runs
- `test_dastest_cache_project_options` - a fresh runner reloads project policies at startup, so a project that forbids persistent_heap fails and writes no cache
- `test_result_cache` - the dastest result cache serves an unchanged passing file, keeps its entry across report-only flags, and misses on changed arguments, edited modules, failures and no --cache-dir

### test_reports.das

- `test_json_file_passing` - --json-file writes a valid report whose required fields, counts, per-test entries and timings match the passing fixture
- `test_json_file_not_created_without_flag` - a run without --json-file leaves no JSON report file behind
- `test_log_color_framing` - under --color no captured line starts with a reset escape, so a colored line never carries its newline inside the color wrap
- `failure_reports_outlive_the_test_heap` - failure reports written to the JSON file outlive the test heap: messages, locations and counts survive a collection and a crash

### test_review_gate.das

- `test_findings_accumulate_and_reset` - findings accumulate with optional line anchors, drive the gate verdict, and clear on reset
- `test_ident_bytes_and_whole_words` - identifier bytes are letters, digits and underscore, and a word matches only as a whole identifier
- `test_kebab_case` - kebab case accepts lowercase words joined by single dashes and rejects underscores, camel case and stray dashes
- `test_find_line` - find_line answers the 1-based line of a needle, including a multi-line needle, and 0 when absent
- `test_das_requires` - das_requires lists the required module paths, skipping comments, indentation noise and ?guard tokens
- `test_cmake_command_blocks` - cmake_command_blocks returns whole multi-line command blocks by exact name, ignoring comments and parens inside quotes
- `test_cmake_command_blocks_edges` - command block scanning survives escaped quotes, parens in comments, space before the paren and an unterminated block
- `test_cmake_words` - cmake_words splits text into words with parens as their own words, quoted runs as one word and comments dropped
- `test_cmake_test_labels` - cmake_test_labels reads every LABELS value of any command, expanded lists included, and stops at its own command's end
- `test_cmake_command_targets` - cmake_command_targets returns the first argument of each named command, even on the next line, and nothing for an empty block
- `test_cmake_commands_are_case_insensitive` - the cmake readers accept a command in any casing, as CMake itself does
- `test_cmake_test_commands` - cmake_test_commands returns each add_test COMMAND's program verbatim and skips an add_test without one
- `test_cmake_list_entries` - cmake_list_entries collects a list variable's entries from set and list(APPEND), once per command and in any casing
- `test_url_host` - url_host extracts the host of absolute and protocol-relative URLs and answers empty for relative paths and comments
- `test_script_urls` - script_urls finds quoted absolute and protocol-relative addresses and ignores comments and relative paths
- `test_html_resource_urls` - html_resource_urls returns only addresses a page loads - src, href of resources, data attributes and inline scripts - not links or meta
- `test_gate_web_third_party` - the web third-party gate reports a disallowed host and document.cookie use, and skips allowed hosts, skipped directories and other file kinds
- `test_gate_lane_census` - the lane census reports a test file that no CMake lane names, ignoring commented lanes, fixtures and files without tests, and reports a missing lane file
- `test_css_urls` - css_urls finds @import and url() addresses, including bare protocol-relative ones, and ignores local paths and comments
- `test_gate_web_third_party_file_kinds` - the web third-party gate scans rst, md and css files but not rule documents or READMEs
- `test_html_resource_urls_edges` - html_resource_urls reads unquoted attribute values and every entry of a srcset
- `test_script_urls_template_literal` - script_urls reads addresses inside a template literal as it does inside quotes
- `test_url_host_is_case_insensitive` - url_host lowercases the host and accepts a scheme in any case
- `test_html_resource_urls_uppercase_script` - an uppercase script tag still bounds an inline script body
- `test_url_host_ipv6_literal` - url_host treats a bracketed IPv6 literal as a host, drops the port after it and rejects an unclosed bracket
- `test_script_urls_multiline_template_literal` - script_urls keeps scanning the later lines of a multi-line template literal while a plain comment still does not count
- `test_html_resource_urls_script_end_tag_exact` - only a real script end tag closes an inline script body, not a longer tag name inside a string
- `test_gate_web_third_party_unreadable_file` - the web third-party gate reports an unreadable file as a finding instead of passing it silently
- `test_html_resource_urls_unclosed_script` - a script with no end tag is scanned to the end of the file, as a browser runs it
- `test_shell_cp_sources` - shell_cp_sources lists every source of each cp into the site tree, dropping flags and quotes and skipping other destinations
- `test_cmake_copy_sources` - cmake_copy_sources lists every source of each copy command whose destination carries the marker and skips the rest
- `test_gate_web_third_party_assets_json` - the web third-party gate scans an .assets.json sidecar entry by entry and leaves other json files alone
- `test_gate_home_paths` - the home-path gate reports unix and drive home directories by line and passes a path already spelled with ~
- `test_prefixed_tokens` - prefixed_tokens collects whole tokens with the prefix, including double-dash modifiers, and skips glued prefixes and bare prefixes in prose
- `test_markdown_table_rows` - markdown_table_rows returns a section's table rows as cells, dropping the alignment row and backticks, and nothing for an absent section
- `test_html_ids` - html_ids collects bare id attributes only, not data-id or look-alike attributes
- `test_html_code_blocks` - html_code_blocks returns blocks of the named class with entities decoded, the offset after the close tag and the opening tag
- `test_markdown_fences` - markdown_fences returns fences of the exact language tag with the offset after the closing fence
- `test_css_selector_tokens` - css_selector_tokens counts a class as defined only by a selector, including those nested in group at-rules, not by comments, values or descriptors
- `test_shell_cp_sources_comments_and_quotes` - shell_cp_sources ends the argument list at a # comment, ignores a commented-out cp and keeps a quoted source with a space whole
- `test_gate_home_paths_unreadable_file` - the home-path gate reports an unreadable file as a finding instead of passing it
- `test_gate_home_paths_missing_file` - the home-path gate reports a path that does not exist as a finding instead of passing it

### test_temp_dir.das

- `test_temp_dir_is_private` - test_temp_dir is one stable, writable directory per run that sits outside the repo tree
- `test_temp_dir_removed_when_the_run_ends` - a child run's temp directory is its own and is gone, files included, once the child ends
- `test_temp_dir_panics_without_a_temp_root` - with no usable temp root the first test_temp_dir call panics and names itself

### test_timeouts.das

- `test_timeout` - a suite that runs past --timeout ends with the timeout message and exit code 124, not a crash
- `test_max_file_time` - --max-file-time fails a completed file past the limit in both modes, and a file's declared test budgets raise its limit
- `test_annotation_args` - [test] carries description and timeout: the claim prints under a FAIL only, an overrun test fails, a mistyped argument does not compile

### test_together.das

- `test_together_runs_every_file` - --together compiles the listed fixtures as one program yet reports each file's tests, results and output lines separately
- `test_together_gives_each_file_a_fresh_context` - --together runs each file in a fresh context, so one file's write to a shared global never reaches the next
- `test_together_refuses_disagreeing_options` - --together refuses a batch whose files disagree on options, reporting one error per file and naming both values

### uncategorized.das

- `test_file_census` - the census reads a file's tests, arms, descriptions, timeouts, header and fence signature from its text, and classes suites, fixtures and scripts apart
- `test_with_folder_filter` - with_folder_filter answers the root's .das_test per folder name, admits every folder where there is none, and refuses a .das_test that does not compile
- `test_reported_batch_meets_the_budget` - a benchmark reports the batch that met the time budget, for both a fast op and a slow one
- `test_isolated_mode` - isolated mode runs a suite in workers, keeps pre-`--` flags, folds crash and panic diagnostics into the failing test's log, and honors --failures-only
